name: Get XHS API Docs
name_zh: 获取小红书 API 文档
summary: Get complete documentation for all implemented XHS (Xiaohongshu) REST APIs in OpenHub, enabling ClawBot to automatically discover available interfaces.
summary_zh: 获取 OpenHub 所有已实现小红书 REST API 的完整说明文档，供 ClawBot 自动发现接口。
description: Resource model: XHS API documentation collection. This endpoint returns the collection of XHS domain REST API documentation currently exposed by OpenHub, allowing clawbot to automatically discover Xiaohongshu interaction capabilities. The URI uses /api/v1/xhs/docs, representing 'documentation resource collection under the XHS domain'; the HTTP method uses GET, semantically for reading. Returns 200 and documentation array on success; returns 500 on failure. The curl examples in the documentation default to port 10088; if the user modifies the REST API port in the settings page, the current configured port should be used.
description_zh: 资源模型：XHS API documentation collection。该接口返回当前 OpenHub 对外暴露的小红书域 REST API 文档集合，供 clawbot 自动发现与小红书交互相关的能力。URI 使用 /api/v1/xhs/docs，表示"小红书领域下的文档资源集合"；HTTP 方法使用 GET，语义为读取。成功时返回 200 和文档数组；失败时返回 500。文档中的 curl 示例默认使用 10088 端口；如果用户在设置页修改了 REST API 端口，应以当前配置端口为准。

name: Query XHS Account Info
summary: Get the current logged-in Xiaohongshu account information, including user ID, nickname, avatar, follower count, and other profile data.
summary_zh: 获取当前登录的小红书账号信息，包括用户 ID、昵称、头像、粉丝数等个人资料数据。
description: Returns the complete raw response from Xiaohongshu's user self-info API. The response contains user profile data including user_id (用户ID), nickname (昵称), image (头像), fans_count (粉丝数), follows_count (关注数), note_count (笔记数), likes_count (获赞数), and other fields. This is the first step for AI to perceive the account state. No data preprocessing is performed; completely passes through the raw XHS API response.
description_zh: 返回小红书用户信息 API 的完整原始响应。响应包含用户资料数据，包括 user_id（用户ID）、nickname（昵称）、image（头像）、fans_count（粉丝数）、follows_count（关注数）、note_count（笔记数）、likes_count（获赞数）等字段。这是 AI 感知账号状态的第一步。不进行任何数据预处理，完全透传小红书 API 原始响应。

name: Query XHS Homefeed
summary: Get the home feed recommendations from Xiaohongshu, returning a list of recommended notes based on user preferences.
summary_zh: 获取小红书主页推荐内容，返回基于用户偏好的推荐笔记列表。
description: Fetches the home feed from Xiaohongshu's recommendation algorithm. Supports pagination via cursor parameter. Returns a list of notes with details including note_id, title, cover image, author info, like count, and other metadata. The feed_type parameter can be used to specify different feed categories. Useful for content discovery and trend analysis.
description_zh: 从小红书推荐算法获取主页信息流。支持通过 cursor 参数分页。返回笔记列表，包含 note_id、标题、封面图、作者信息、点赞数等元数据。feed_type 参数可用于指定不同的信息流分类。适用于内容发现和趋势分析。
response: {"success":true,"data":{"items":[{"id":"note123","title":"推荐笔记标题","type":"normal","display_title":"展示标题","user":{"nickname":"作者昵称","image":"头像URL"},"interact_info":{"liked_count":100,"collected_count":50,"comment_count":20}}],"cursor":"next_cursor_value"}}

name: Query XHS Note Detail
summary: Get detailed information about a specific Xiaohongshu note, including content, images, comments, and interaction data.
summary_zh: 获取指定小红书笔记的详细信息，包括内容、图片、评论和互动数据。
description: Fetches complete details of a specific note from Xiaohongshu. Requires note_id parameter. Returns note content (text), image list, video URL (if applicable), author info, tags, mentions, like/collect/comment counts, and timestamp. Essential for content analysis and interaction decisions.
description_zh: 获取小红书指定笔记的完整详情。需要 note_id 参数。返回笔记内容（文本）、图片列表、视频 URL（如有）、作者信息、标签、提及、点赞/收藏/评论数和时间戳。是内容分析和互动决策的基础。
response: {"success":true,"data":{"id":"note123","title":"笔记标题","desc":"笔记正文内容","type":"normal","user":{"user_id":"user456","nickname":"作者昵称"},"image_list":[{"url":"https://sns-img.xhscdn.com/img.jpg"}],"interact_info":{"liked_count":100,"collected_count":50,"comment_count":20,"share_count":10},"time":1717142400000}}

name: Query XHS Search Notes
summary: Search for notes on Xiaohongshu by keyword, with support for filtering by type, sort order, and pagination.
summary_zh: 通过关键词搜索小红书笔记，支持按类型、排序和分页过滤。
description: Performs a keyword search on Xiaohongshu's note database. Supports multiple filter parameters including search_type (note type), sort_type (relevance/time), and pagination via cursor. Returns a list of matching notes with summary info. Essential for content discovery, trend monitoring, and competitive analysis.
description_zh: 在小红书笔记数据库中执行关键词搜索。支持多种过滤参数，包括 search_type（笔记类型）、sort_type（相关性/时间排序）以及通过 cursor 分页。返回匹配笔记列表及摘要信息。是内容发现、趋势监控和竞品分析的核心功能。
response: {"success":true,"data":{"items":[{"id":"note123","title":"搜索结果标题","display_title":"展示标题","user":{"nickname":"作者"},"interact_info":{"liked_count":100}}],"cursor":"next_cursor"}}

name: Query XHS User Notes
name_zh: 获取小红书用户笔记列表
summary: Get the list of notes published by a specific Xiaohongshu user, with pagination support.
summary_zh: 获取指定小红书用户发布的笔记列表，支持分页。
description: Fetches all public notes from a specific user's profile. Requires user_id parameter. Returns a paginated list of notes with thumbnails, titles, and interaction stats. Useful for analyzing user content strategy and engagement patterns.
description_zh: 获取指定用户主页的所有公开笔记。需要 user_id 参数。返回分页的笔记列表，包含缩略图、标题和互动统计。适用于分析用户内容策略和互动模式。

name: Get XHS Note Comments
summary: Get comments for a specific Xiaohongshu note, including both first-level and nested replies.
summary_zh: 获取指定小红书笔记的评论，包括一级评论和嵌套回复。
description: Fetches the comment thread for a specific note. Requires note_id parameter. Supports cursor-based pagination. Returns comments with user info, content, timestamps, like counts, and nested reply information. Essential for community engagement analysis and automated reply scenarios.
description_zh: 获取指定笔记的评论线程。需要 note_id 参数。支持基于 cursor 的分页。返回评论包含用户信息、内容、时间戳、点赞数和嵌套回复信息。是社区互动分析和自动回复场景的核心功能。
response: {"success":true,"data":{"comments":[{"id":"comment123","content":"评论内容","user":{"user_id":"user789","nickname":"评论者"},"like_count":10,"sub_comment_count":2,"time":1717142400000,"sub_comments":[{"id":"subcomment456","content":"回复内容","user":{"nickname":"回复者"}}]}],"cursor":"next_cursor"}}

name: Get XHS User Info
summary: Get detailed profile information for a specific Xiaohongshu user by user ID.
summary_zh: 通过用户 ID 获取指定小红书用户的详细资料信息。
description: Fetches public profile information for any Xiaohongshu user. Requires user_id parameter. Returns user details including nickname, avatar, bio, follower/following counts, note count, and verification status. Essential for user research and relationship building.
description_zh: 获取任意小红书用户的公开资料信息。需要 user_id 参数。返回用户详情，包括昵称、头像、简介、粉丝/关注数、笔记数和认证状态。是用户研究和关系建立的基础。

name: Search XHS Topics
summary: Search for topics (hashtags) on Xiaohongshu by keyword, returning matching topic names and usage statistics.
summary_zh: 通过关键词搜索小红书话题（标签），返回匹配的话题名称和使用统计。
description: Searches Xiaohongshu's topic database by keyword. Requires keyword parameter. Returns a list of matching topics with their names, IDs, note counts, and popularity metrics. Essential for content strategy planning and trend identification.
description_zh: 在小红书话题数据库中搜索关键词。需要 keyword 参数。返回匹配话题列表，包含名称、ID、笔记数和热度指标。是内容策略规划和趋势识别的核心功能。

name: Get XHS Notifications
summary: Get notification messages from Xiaohongshu, including comments, likes, follows, and mentions.
summary_zh: 获取小红书的消息通知，包括评论、点赞、关注和提及。
description: Fetches notification data from Xiaohongshu. Supports filtering by notification type via type parameter. Returns unread counts and notification list with details. Types include: comments (评论), likes (点赞), follows (关注), mentions (@). Essential for monitoring account engagement and responding to user interactions.
description_zh: 获取小红书通知数据。支持通过 type 参数过滤通知类型。返回未读数和通知详情列表。类型包括：comments（评论）、likes（点赞）、follows（关注）、mentions（@提及）。是监控账号互动和响应用户交互的核心功能。
response: {"success":true,"data":{"unread_count":{"total":10,"comment":5,"like":3,"follow":2},"notifications":[{"type":"comment","content":"用户评论了你的笔记","user":{"nickname":"评论者"},"note_id":"note123","time":1717142400000}]}}

name: Get XHS Published Notes
name_zh: 获取小红书已发布笔记
summary: Get the list of notes published by the current logged-in account from the creator center.
summary_zh: 从创作者中心获取当前登录账号已发布的笔记列表。
description: Fetches the list of notes published by the logged-in account from Xiaohongshu's creator center. Returns comprehensive note data including status (published/draft), view count, engagement metrics, and publication time. Supports cursor-based pagination. Essential for content performance monitoring and account management.
description_zh: 从小红书创作者中心获取当前登录账号发布的笔记列表。返回完整笔记数据，包括状态（已发布/草稿）、浏览量、互动指标和发布时间。支持基于 cursor 的分页。是内容表现监控和账号管理的核心功能。

name: XHS Search Filter
summary: Get available search filter options for Xiaohongshu search functionality.
summary_zh: 获取小红书搜索功能的可用过滤选项。
description: Returns the list of available search filters and their options for Xiaohongshu search. Includes filter categories like note type, time range, location, and sort options. Useful for understanding search capabilities and building advanced search queries.
description_zh: 返回小红书搜索可用的过滤器和选项列表。包括笔记类型、时间范围、地点和排序选项等过滤分类。适用于了解搜索能力和构建高级搜索查询。

name: Search XHS Users
summary: Search for Xiaohongshu users by keyword, used as a prerequisite for @ mentions in comments and notes.
summary_zh: 通过关键词搜索小红书用户，用于评论和笔记中 @ 提及的前置搜索。
description: Searches for users on Xiaohongshu by keyword. Requires keyword parameter. Returns a list of matching users with their user_id, nickname, avatar, and follower count. This API is essential for finding users to @ mention in comments or notes. The search results are prioritized by relevance and follower count.
description_zh: 在小红书搜索用户。需要 keyword 参数。返回匹配用户列表，包含 user_id、昵称、头像和粉丝数。此 API 是在评论或笔记中 @ 提及用户的前置功能。搜索结果按相关性和粉丝数排序。

name: Get XHS Intimacy List
summary: Get the list of friends/followed users for @ mention suggestions, used as a prerequisite for @ mentions in comments.
summary_zh: 获取好友/已关注用户列表用于 @ 提及建议，是评论中 @ 提及的前置功能。
description: Fetches the list of users that the current account frequently interacts with or follows. Returns users sorted by interaction frequency. This API is used to provide @ mention suggestions when composing comments or notes. The list includes user_id, nickname, and avatar for each user.
description_zh: 获取当前账号频繁互动或关注的用户列表。返回按互动频率排序的用户。此 API 用于在撰写评论或笔记时提供 @ 提及建议。列表包含每个用户的 user_id、昵称和头像。

name: Publish XHS Image Note
summary: Publish a new image-text note on Xiaohongshu with title, content, images, privacy settings, topics, and scheduled publish time.
summary_zh: 在小红书发布新的图文笔记，包含标题、正文、图片、隐私设置、话题和定时发布。
description: Publishes a new image-text note to Xiaohongshu. Requires title, desc (content), and images array (base64 encoded). Supports privacy_type (0=public, 1=private, 3=specific users, 4=friends), privacy_user_ids (for type=3), topics (array of {id, name} objects), and scheduled_publish_time (Unix timestamp in seconds). Topics are automatically embedded in desc with #topic[话题]# format. Images are uploaded to COS automatically. Returns note_id on success.
description_zh: 在小红书发布新的图文笔记。需要 title、desc（正文）和 images 数组（base64 编码）。支持 privacy_type（0=公开 1=私密 3=指定人 4=好友）、privacy_user_ids（type=3 时填用户 ID 列表）、topics（{id, name} 对象数组）、scheduled_publish_time（Unix 秒级时间戳）。话题会自动以 #话题[话题]# 格式嵌入正文。图片自动上传到 COS。成功时返回 note_id。
curl: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10088/api/v1/xhs/publish -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"笔记标题","desc":"笔记正文","images":[{"base64":"...","mimeType":"image/jpeg"}],"privacy_type":0,"topics":[{"id":"624d11eb000000000101e223","name":"大模型"}],"scheduled_publish_time":1780418940}'
request_body: {"title":"笔记标题","desc":"笔记正文内容","images":[{"base64":"base64_encoded_image_data","mimeType":"image/jpeg"}],"privacy_type":0,"privacy_user_ids":[],"topics":[{"id":"624d11eb000000000101e223","name":"大模型"}],"scheduled_publish_time":1780418940}

name: Publish XHS Video Note
summary: Publish a new video note on Xiaohongshu with title, description, video, privacy settings, topics, cover image, and scheduled publish time.
summary_zh: 在小红书发布新的视频笔记，包含标题、描述、视频、隐私设置、话题、封面图和定时发布。
description: Publishes a new video note to Xiaohongshu. Requires title, desc, and video (base64 encoded). Supports privacy_type (0=public, 1=private, 3=specific users, 4=friends), privacy_user_ids (for type=3), topics (array of {id, name} objects), cover (optional base64 cover image), and scheduled_publish_time (Unix timestamp in seconds). Topics are automatically embedded in desc with #topic[话题]# format. Video and cover are uploaded to COS automatically. Returns note_id on success.
description_zh: 在小红书发布新的视频笔记。需要 title、desc 和 video（base64 编码）。支持 privacy_type（0=公开 1=私密 3=指定人 4=好友）、privacy_user_ids（type=3 时填用户 ID 列表）、topics（{id, name} 对象数组）、cover（可选 base64 封面图）、scheduled_publish_time（Unix 秒级时间戳）。话题会自动以 #话题[话题]# 格式嵌入正文。视频和封面自动上传到 COS。成功时返回 note_id。
curl: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10088/api/v1/xhs/publish_video -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"视频标题","desc":"视频描述","video":{"base64":"...","mimeType":"video/mp4"},"privacy_type":0,"topics":[{"id":"624d11eb000000000101e223","name":"大模型"}],"scheduled_publish_time":1780418940}'
request_body: {"title":"视频标题","desc":"视频描述内容","video":{"base64":"base64_encoded_video_data","mimeType":"video/mp4"},"cover":{"base64":"base64_encoded_cover_data","mimeType":"image/jpeg"},"privacy_type":0,"privacy_user_ids":[],"topics":[{"id":"624d11eb000000000101e223","name":"大模型"}],"scheduled_publish_time":1780418940}

name: Post XHS Comment
summary: Post a comment or reply on a Xiaohongshu note, supporting @ mentions.
summary_zh: 在小红书笔记发布评论或回复，支持 @ 提及。
description: Posts a new comment or reply on a Xiaohongshu note. Requires note_id and content. For replying to an existing comment, include comment_id (parent comment ID). Supports @ mentions via at_users array (user IDs obtained from search_users or intimacy_list). Returns comment_id on success. Note: Rate limiting applies; wait 3-8 seconds between consecutive comments.
description_zh: 在小红书笔记发布新评论或回复。需要 note_id 和 content。回复现有评论时需包含 comment_id（父评论 ID）。支持通过 at_users 数组 @ 提及用户（用户 ID 从 search_users 或 intimacy_list 获取）。成功时返回 comment_id。注意：有频率限制，连续评论需等待 3-8 秒。
curl: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10088/api/v1/xhs/comment -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"note_id":"note123","content":"评论内容","at_users":["user456"]}'

name: Like XHS Note
summary: Like a specific Xiaohongshu note to show appreciation.
summary_zh: 点赞指定的小红书笔记。
description: Likes a specific note on Xiaohongshu. Requires note_oid parameter (the note OID, not note_id). Returns success status and updated like count. This is a write operation; rate limiting applies with 3-8 seconds random delay recommended between consecutive likes. Essential for engagement automation.
description_zh: 点赞小红书指定笔记。需要 note_oid 参数（笔记的 OID，不是 note_id）。返回成功状态和更新后的点赞数。这是写操作；有频率限制，建议连续点赞间隔 3-8 秒随机延迟。是互动自动化的核心功能。

name: Follow XHS User
summary: Follow a specific Xiaohongshu user to subscribe to their content.
summary_zh: 关注指定的小红书用户以订阅其内容。
description: Follows a specific user on Xiaohongshu. Requires target_user_id parameter (the user's rid, without hash suffix). Returns success status. This is a write operation; rate limiting applies with 3-8 seconds random delay recommended between consecutive follows. Essential for relationship building and audience expansion.
description_zh: 关注小红书指定用户。需要 target_user_id 参数（用户的 rid，不含 hash 后缀）。返回成功状态。这是写操作；有频率限制，建议连续关注间隔 3-8 秒随机延迟。是关系建立和受众扩展的核心功能。

name: Unlike XHS Note
summary: Remove a like from a previously liked Xiaohongshu note.
summary_zh: 取消之前点赞的小红书笔记的点赞。
description: Removes a like from a previously liked note on Xiaohongshu. Requires note_oid parameter (the note OID, not note_id). Returns success status. This is a write operation; rate limiting applies. Useful for correcting accidental likes or managing engagement history.
description_zh: 取消小红书之前点赞的笔记。需要 note_oid 参数（笔记的 OID，不是 note_id）。返回成功状态。这是写操作；有频率限制。适用于纠正误点赞或管理互动历史。

name: Unfollow XHS User
summary: Unfollow a previously followed Xiaohongshu user.
summary_zh: 取消之前关注的小红书用户。
description: Unfollows a previously followed user on Xiaohongshu. Requires target_user_id parameter (the user's rid, without hash suffix). Returns success status. This is a write operation; rate limiting applies. Useful for managing following list and account hygiene.
description_zh: 取消小红书之前关注的用户。需要 target_user_id 参数（用户的 rid，不含 hash 后缀）。返回成功状态。这是写操作；有频率限制。适用于管理关注列表和账号维护。

name: Collect XHS Note
summary: Add a Xiaohongshu note to the collection/bookmarks for later reference.
summary_zh: 将小红书笔记添加到收藏以便后续查看。
description: Collects/bookmarks a specific note on Xiaohongshu. Requires note_id parameter. Returns success status. This is a write operation; rate limiting applies. Essential for content curation and later reference.
description_zh: 收藏小红书指定笔记。需要 note_id 参数。返回成功状态。这是写操作；有频率限制。是内容整理和后续查看的核心功能。

name: Delete XHS Comment
summary: Delete a comment posted by the current account on a Xiaohongshu note.
summary_zh: 删除当前账号在小红书笔记上发布的评论。
description: Deletes a comment posted by the current account. Requires both note_id and comment_id parameters. Returns success status. This is a write operation; use with caution. Useful for content moderation and error correction.
description_zh: 删除当前账号发布的评论。需要 note_id 和 comment_id 两个参数。返回成功状态。这是写操作；请谨慎使用。适用于内容审核和错误纠正。

name: Delete XHS Note
summary: Delete a note published by the current account on Xiaohongshu.
summary_zh: 删除当前账号在小红书发布的笔记。
description: Deletes a note published by the current account. Requires note_id parameter. Returns success status. This is a destructive write operation; use with extreme caution as the action is irreversible. Useful for content management and removing outdated content.
description_zh: 删除当前账号发布的笔记。需要 note_id 参数。返回成功状态。这是破坏性写操作；请极度谨慎使用，因为操作不可逆。适用于内容管理和移除过时内容。

name: Get XHS Friend Fans List
name_zh: 获取小红书好友粉丝列表
summary: Get the list of friends and fans for privacy settings when publishing notes with specific user visibility (privacy_type=3).
summary_zh: 获取好友和粉丝列表，用于发布笔记时设置指定人可见（privacy_type=3）。
description: Fetches the list of friends and fans that can be selected for privacy_type=3 (specific users visible) when publishing notes. Supports cursor-based pagination via cursor and size parameters. Returns user list with user_id, nickname, and avatar. Essential prerequisite for publishing notes with specific user visibility.
description_zh: 获取可选择的好友和粉丝列表，用于发布笔记时设置 privacy_type=3（指定人可见）。支持通过 cursor 和 size 参数分页。返回用户列表，包含 user_id、昵称和头像。是发布指定人可见笔记的必需前置功能。

name: Create XHS Collection
summary: Create a new collection (album) on Xiaohongshu to organize notes, with optional cover image.
summary_zh: 在小红书创建新的合集（专辑）来组织笔记，支持可选封面图。
description: Creates a new collection on Xiaohongshu. Requires name and desc parameters. Supports optional cover parameter (base64 encoded image with mimeType). Cover image is uploaded to COS automatically. Returns collection_id on success. Collections are used to organize related notes into albums. Requires creator.xiaohongshu.com tab to be open.
description_zh: 在小红书创建新合集。需要 name 和 desc 参数。支持可选 cover 参数（base64 编码图片及 mimeType）。封面图自动上传到 COS。成功时返回 collection_id。合集用于将相关笔记组织成专辑。需要 creator.xiaohongshu.com 标签页已打开。
curl: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10088/api/v1/xhs/collection/create -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"合集名称","desc":"合集简介","cover":{"base64":"...","mimeType":"image/jpeg"}}'

name: List XHS Collections
summary: Get the list of collections created by the current account, with pagination support.
summary_zh: 获取当前账号创建的合集列表，支持分页。
description: Fetches the list of collections created by the current account. Supports cursor-based pagination via cursor parameter. Returns collection list with id, name, desc, icon (cover image), and note_num (number of notes in collection). Requires creator.xiaohongshu.com tab to be open.
description_zh: 获取当前账号创建的合集列表。支持通过 cursor 参数分页。返回合集列表，包含 id、name、desc、icon（封面图）和 note_num（合集内笔记数）。需要 creator.xiaohongshu.com 标签页已打开。

name: List XHS Collection Notes
name_zh: 查询小红书合集内笔记
summary: Get the list of notes in a specific collection.
summary_zh: 获取指定合集内的笔记列表。
description: Fetches the list of notes in a specific collection. Requires collection_id parameter. Returns note list with note details. Useful for managing collection content and verifying note organization. Requires creator.xiaohongshu.com tab to be open.
description_zh: 获取指定合集内的笔记列表。需要 collection_id 参数。返回笔记列表及详情。适用于管理合集内容和验证笔记组织。需要 creator.xiaohongshu.com 标签页已打开。

name: Update XHS Collection
summary: Update the name, description, or cover image of an existing collection.
summary_zh: 更新现有合集的名称、简介或封面图。
description: Updates an existing collection's information. Requires collection_id, name, and desc parameters. Supports optional cover parameter (base64 encoded image with mimeType) to update cover image. If cover is not provided, the existing cover is retained. Returns success status. Requires creator.xiaohongshu.com tab to be open.
description_zh: 更新现有合集信息。需要 collection_id、name 和 desc 参数。支持可选 cover 参数（base64 编码图片及 mimeType）来更新封面图。如果不提供 cover，则保留现有封面。返回成功状态。需要 creator.xiaohongshu.com 标签页已打开。
curl: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10088/api/v1/xhs/collection/update -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"collection_id":"6a1d1c310518000000000001","name":"新名称","desc":"新简介","cover":{"base64":"...","mimeType":"image/jpeg"}}'
